saw_lines: Families buy a digitizing kit once, when one old tape or album suddenly feels urgent. They rarely buy it for themselves.
So the sale is won in the opening line where the old tape gets named before anything else.
Your ads show no proof number across all 29 live ads, so a first-time buyer has no reason to trust the box. Collect one review count and open with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: None of your 29 live ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has nothing concrete to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, a review count or orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it on the creative.
Creator posts run as brand ads

3 of 21 ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so the audience reads a paid brand ad, not a customer story. Whitelist them from the creator accounts and cut three variations of the strongest one.

11 Shop now ads send buyers to your homepage instead of the product on screen. Each extra step loses buyers who already chose a kit. Point each of those 11 to the matching product page so clicks land on the item.

27 ads have run 60 or more days, yet none of your 2 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening line and changing only the second sentence.

ads_1: Creator video ads sent to product pages, with a review count added
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and YouTube
